Time-of-Use (TOU) tariff structures differentiate rates by time of day. Peak hours typically run 8 AM to 8 PM on weekdays, carrying higher volumetric rates due to grid demand. Off-peak hours (10 PM to 8 AM and weekends) offer discounted delivery and supply rates, encouraging load shifting.
